description: Read one of Sendora's documents whole, as Markdown: a guide (sendora://docs/…), an API operation (sendora://reference/…), the error codes (sendora://errors) or an SDK's README and rules for agents (sendora://sdk/readme and sendora://sdk/skill for TypeScript, sendora://sdk/python/readme and sendora://sdk/python/skill for Python, sendora://sdk/php/readme and sendora://sdk/php/skill for PHP, and sendora://sdk/laravel/readme for Laravel). sendora://index lists every document; search_docs finds the right one.

uri.description: A document's address, such as sendora://index.

name: read_doc
title: Read a Sendora document
